title: 雅思口语模拟
summary: 按 Part 1 / 2 / 3 的考官流程走一遍，考完给四项维度参考分。

stages.title: Part 1 · 简介问答
stages.instructions: 三个日常问题，每个答 2–3 句（25 词以上），别只回一个词。
prompts: Let's talk about where you live. Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What do you like most about the area you live in?
How do you usually spend your weekends?

stages.title: Part 2 · 个人陈述
stages.instructions: 给你一张题卡，连续说 1–2 分钟（80 词以上），中间不要停。
prompts: Describe a skill you learned that turned out to be useful. Say what it is, how you learned it, and why it has been useful to you.

stages.title: Part 3 · 深入讨论
stages.instructions: 和考官讨论抽象问题，每问 40 词以上，尽量用 because / although 展开。
prompts: Why do you think some people find it hard to keep learning new skills as adults?
Should schools teach practical skills instead of academic subjects?
How might the way people learn change in the next twenty years?
